Class AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E extends PanelElement, B extends AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E,B>>

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E,B>
Type Parameters:
E - the element built
B - the concrete builder, so a chain stays typed end to end
Direct Known Subclasses:
Button.Builder, Checkbox.Builder, Divider.Builder, Flow.Builder, Icon.Builder, InfoBox.Builder, ItemDisplay.Builder, com.trevlar.menukit.api.element.PopoverControl.Builder, ProgressBar.Builder, Radio.Builder, ScrollContainer.Builder, Section.Builder, Slider.Builder, SlotElement.Builder, SlotFlowElement.Builder, Tabs.Builder, TextField.Builder, TextLabel.Builder, Toggle.Builder
Enclosing class:
AbstractPanelElement
public abstract static class AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E extends PanelElement, B extends AbstractPanelElement.Builder<E,B>> extends Object
The builder every MenuKit element's builder extends: the shared vocabulary, in one place, with the same names everywhere. A concrete builder adds its element's own settings, validates in build(), and makes size(int, int) public when its element takes one.

    • build

      public abstract E build()
      Builds the element. Throws IllegalStateException when a required setting is missing.

    • at

      public B at(int x, int y)
      Panel-local position: where the element sits in its panel's content area. Default (0, 0).

    • size

      protected B size(int width, int height)
      The element's size in pixels. Protected here: a builder whose element takes a size overrides this as public; an element that sizes itself from its content has none to take.

    • visibleWhen

      public B visibleWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Shown only while condition holds, read every frame. A hidden element is fully inert.

    • disabledWhen

      public B disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Greyed and inert while condition holds, read every frame. On a container (a Section, Tabs, ScrollContainer, Flow) it disables everything inside as well.

    • tooltip

      public B tooltip(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component text)

      public B tooltip(Supplier<net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> text)

    • opaque

      public B opaque(boolean opaque)
      Whether the element is solid on a transparent panel (Panel.opaque(false)): there only solid, interactive elements claim input, so a non-opaque one lets clicks, hover and tooltips through to what is behind it. On an opaque panel it makes no difference (the panel claims its whole rectangle, §0065). Default true. Was setElementOpaque.

    • declId

      public B declId(String id)
      A stable id within the panel, for the window's address of this element, used instead of its position in the panel's element list. Use it when the list's order is not a reliable handle (elements included conditionally).

    • require

      protected final void require(boolean ok, String message)
      Throws IllegalStateException naming the builder when ok is false.
